configurations.name: khabardar-web
configurations.//: Dev server with hot reload. Watchman is prepended to PATH because Metro's Windows fallback watcher (recursive fs.watch) hangs and times out after 240s. Adjust the path if watchman lives elsewhere; drop it on macOS/Linux.

configurations.name: khabardar-static
configurations.//: Serves the exported static build (npm run web:export first). No file watcher, so this always starts — the reliable path for verification and screenshots on Windows.
